about_zh: 编辑器、终端、构建、测试——日常写代码的那一圈。

repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: Pi 是一个自扩展的 AI 编码 Agent 工具链，提供统一的 LLM API 抽象层，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多模型提供商。包含交互式 CLI、终端 UI 库和 Slack 机器人，具备工具调用和状态管理能力。专为开发者设计，通过真实开源项目会话数据持续优化，实现生产级 AI 自动化编程。
repos.summary_en: Pi is a self-extensible AI coding agent toolkit featuring a unified LLM API abstraction layer supporting multiple providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. It includes an interactive CLI, terminal UI library with differential rendering, web UI components, and Slack bot integration with robust tool calling and state management capabilities. Designed for developers, it enables production-grade AI automation programming and continuously improves through real-world open-source session data collection and sharing, with hardened supply-chain security for enterprise deployment.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent-Reach 为 AI 智能体提供命令行式全网接入，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台，自动处理认证与反爬，零 API 费用实现跨平台内容读取与搜索。
repos.summary_en: Agent-Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with cross-platform internet access across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu. It automatically handles authentication, anti-bot measures, and data cleaning—zero API fees, one command to install.

repos.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
repos.summary_zh: OpenCut 是开源的 CapCut 替代品，提供 Web、桌面和移动端视频编辑。基于 Next.js 和 React 构建，采用 Zustand 状态管理与 TypeScript 类型安全。支持时间线多轨道编辑和实时预览，核心优势是隐私优先（视频本地处理）、无订阅费用和水印，为商业闭源编辑器提供强大替代方案。
repos.summary_en: OpenCut is a free, open-source alternative to CapCut that provides comprehensive video editing capabilities for web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Built on Next.js and React with Zustand state management, it delivers timeline-based multi-track editing with real-time preview. The project emphasizes privacy by processing videos entirely on-device, eliminating subscriptions and watermarks. Leveraging TypeScript, Bun, and Docker, OpenCut offers a streamlined development experience and a robust, privacy-first substitute for commercial video editing solutions.

repos.description: simple terminal UI for git commands
repos.summary_zh: lazygit 是用 Go 语言开发的终端 Git 客户端，为开发者提供简洁的交互式界面来执行 Git 命令。它通过可视化操作简化了提交、推送、分支管理等复杂流程，支持跨平台使用，显著提升版本控制效率，是开发者日常 Git 操作的效率利器。
repos.summary_en: lazygit is a lightweight terminal UI for Git commands, developed in Go language. It provides developers with an intuitive interactive interface to simplify complex Git workflows including committing, pushing, branch management, and conflict resolution. This cross-platform tool dramatically enhances version control efficiency by visualizing repository states and enabling keyboard-driven operations. Designed for developers seeking productivity in daily Git usage, lazygit reduces command memorization overhead and streamlines the development process.

repos.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
repos.summary_zh: Strix 是一款开源的 AI 安全代理工具，通过模拟真实黑客行为动态扫描应用漏洞。核心亮点包括：团队协作模式实现高效漏洞挖掘、生成可验证的 PoC 而非误报、提供一键自动修复方案，并支持 CI/CD 集成。适用于快速渗透测试、Bug 赏金自动化和应用安全测试，大幅提升安全测试效率。
repos.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered security agent that simulates real hackers to dynamically discover and validate application vulnerabilities. Key features include: collaborative agent teams for efficient scanning, real PoC generation eliminating false positives, one-click autofix capabilities, and seamless CI/CD integration. Ideal for rapid penetration testing, bug bounty automation, and application security testing, dramatically accelerating security remediation.

repos.description: Warp is an agentic development environment, born out of the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Warp 是一款诞生于终端的智能体开发环境，深度集成 AI 编码助手并支持 Claude Code 等第三方 CLI 智能体。其 Oz 系统可自动化处理开源项目的 issue 管理、PR 审查等协作流程，提供实时智能体会话追踪与贡献者仪表板。采用 AGPL 开源协议，重塑开发者与 AI 协同编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Warp is an agentic development environment born from the terminal, deeply integrating AI coding assistants and supporting third-party CLI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Its proprietary Oz system automates open-source project workflows including issue triage, PR reviews, spec writing, and community management. The platform provides real-time agent session tracking via build.warp.dev and comprehensive contributor dashboards. With OpenAI as founding sponsor and GPT-powered agentic workflows, Warp redefines developer-AI collaboration under AGPL open-source licensing while offering an MIT-licensed UI framework.

repos.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: GitHubDaily 是一个运营近十年的开源项目策展平台，累计分享超10000个高质量开源项目。通过GitHub仓库、公众号、微博等多渠道，系统化推荐技术教程、开发者工具与行业资讯，核心价值在于从海量项目中筛选高价值内容，并按AI工具、开发工具等维度结构化整理，助力开发者拓展技术视野与提升编程能力。
repos.summary_en: GitHubDaily is a decade-old open source curation platform that has shared over 10,000 high-quality projects. Through multiple channels including GitHub, WeChat, and Twitter, it systematically recommends technical tutorials, developer tools, and industry insights. Its core value lies in filtering high-value content from massive repositories and organizing it into structured categories like AI tools and development utilities, helping developers expand technical horizons and enhance programming skills.

repos.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
repos.summary_zh: Lightpanda 是为 AI 和自动化设计的开源无头浏览器，内存占用仅为 Chrome 的 1/9，执行速度快 11 倍。支持 JavaScript 和主流自动化框架，适用于网页爬虫、AI 代理和测试场景。
repos.summary_en: Lightpanda is an open-source headless browser designed specifically for AI and automation tasks. It dramatically reduces memory usage by 9x compared to Chrome while delivering 11x faster execution speeds. The browser supports JavaScript execution and Web APIs, and maintains compatibility with popular automation frameworks like Playwright, Puppeteer, and chromedp through the Chrome DevTools Protocol, making it ideal for web scraping, AI agent training, and automated testing.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提示词工程优化的 AI 应用工具，支持多模型集成与 MCP 协议。通过智能优化、对比测试和高级调试模式，显著提升 LLM 输出质量与稳定性。提供 Web、桌面、Chrome 插件及 Docker 多端部署，采用纯前端架构确保数据安全，适用于角色扮演、知识提取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is a powerful AI application tool dedicated to prompt engineering optimization, supporting multi-model integration and MCP protocol compatibility. It significantly improves LLM output quality and stability through intelligent prompt refinement, real-time A/B testing, and advanced debugging features including context variables and function calling. The tool offers versatile deployment options—Web, desktop, Chrome extension, and Docker—with a pure frontend architecture that ensures data security by processing everything client-side. Perfect for scenarios like roleplay simulation, knowledge graph extraction, and creative writing collaboration.

repos.description: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale 是一款开源终端 AI 编程智能体，基于 Rust 构建，支持任意大模型（云端或本地）。它能自主读取项目、编辑文件、执行命令并自我校验，提供交互式 TUI、无头模式及 PR 审查等多种运行方式，适用于自动化代码修复与开发者效率提升。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source terminal-based AI coding agent built in Rust, supporting any LLM provider (hosted or local). It autonomously reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and self-verifies results. Offers interactive TUI, headless CI mode, and PR review for developer productivity.

repos.description: Playwright MCP server
repos.summary_zh: Playwright MCP是微软推出的Model Context Protocol服务器，通过Playwright可访问性树为LLM提供浏览器自动化能力。它摒弃截图方案，采用结构化快照实现确定性操作，适用于探索性测试、自愈脚本和长周期自治工作流。相比CLI工具，MCP模式更适合需要持久状态和深度页面推理的智能体场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwright MCP is a Microsoft Model Context Protocol server that enables LLMs to automate browsers through Playwright's accessibility tree. It replaces screenshot-based approaches with structured snapshots for deterministic, vision-free interactions. Designed for exploratory automation, self-healing tests, and persistent autonomous workflows, it maintains continuous browser context at the cost of higher token usage. The server integrates seamlessly with MCP-compatible clients including VS Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Windsurf, providing a lightweight yet powerful bridge between language models and web automation with rich introspection capabilities.

repos.description: The headless browser for AI agents and web scraping
repos.summary_zh: Obscura是用Rust编写的轻量级无头浏览器，专为AI智能体和网页爬虫设计。它内置V8引擎执行真实JavaScript，支持Chrome DevTools Protocol，完全兼容Puppeteer/Playwright API。相比Chrome，内存占用仅30MB（降低85%），启动瞬时，内置反检测功能，是自动化任务的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: Obscura is a lightweight headless browser engine written in Rust, purpose-built for AI agents and large-scale web scraping applications. It executes real JavaScript through the V8 engine, fully supports Chrome DevTools Protocol, and serves as a drop-in replacement for both Puppeteer and Playwright. Compared to traditional headless Chrome, Obscura reduces memory usage by 85% to just 30MB, achieves instant startup, and features built-in anti-detection mechanisms. This combination of performance, compatibility, and stealth makes it ideal for scalable browser automation tasks.

repos.description: Stealth Chromium that passes every bot detection test. Drop-in Playwright replacement with source-level fingerprint patches. 50+ tests passed.
repos.summary_zh: CloakBrowser 是一款源码级深度改造的隐身 Chromium 浏览器，通过 58 个 C++ 补丁从底层消除自动化指纹，完美绕过 Cloudflare Turnstile、reCAPTCHA v3 等 30+ 机器人检测系统。无缝兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer API，一行代码替换，内置类人行为模拟，为网页爬虫、数据采集和自动化测试提供终极反检测解决方案。
repos.summary_en: CloakBrowser is a stealth Chromium browser with 58 source-level C++ patches that fundamentally eliminate automation fingerprints. It achieves a 0.9 reCAPTCHA v3 score and passes 30+ bot detection tests including Cloudflare Turnstile and FingerprintJS. Offering seamless Playwright/Puppeteer API compatibility with one-line code replacement, built-in human-like behavior simulation, and automatic binary updates, it delivers the ultimate anti-detection solution for web scraping, data collection, and automation tasks.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一款将任意网站转换为命令行接口的自动化工具，核心在于让 AI 智能体通过已登录的浏览器操作网页（导航、填表、点击、数据提取）。内置 Bilibili、知乎等适配器，通过浏览器扩展与本地守护进程实现安全交互，支持自定义命令扩展，并集成本地工具与 Electron 应用，实现高效自动化与 AI 驱动交互。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is an automation tool that converts any website into a command-line interface (CLI), enabling AI agents to operate websites via a logged-in browser for navigation, form filling, clicking, and data extraction. It provides built-in adapters for platforms like Bilibili and Zhihu, a browser extension with a local daemon, and allows custom command extensions. It also integrates local tools and Electron apps, serving as a versatile hub for human and AI-driven automation workflows.

repos.description: Open-source 3D architecture software for AECO, scan-to-BIM. Agent-friendly, browser-first, MCP, CLI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Web 的 3D 建筑编辑器，提供浏览器内专业级 BIM 编辑能力。采用 React Three Fiber + WebGPU 实现高性能渲染，Turborepo  monorepo 架构分离核心逻辑与渲染层，Zustand 分层状态管理配合 IndexedDB 持久化与 Zundo 撤销重做，支持建筑模型的节点化数据管理与实时空间查询。
repos.summary_en: A web-based 3D building editor delivering professional BIM capabilities in-browser. Built on React Three Fiber + WebGPU for high-performance rendering, Turborepo monorepo architecture separates core logic from rendering, with layered Zustand state management, IndexedDB persistence, and Zundo undo/redo. Enables node-based building data management and real-time spatial queries.

repos.description: A maintained, feature-rich and performance oriented, neofetch like system information tool.
repos.summary_zh: Fastfetch 是一款用 C 语言编写的高性能系统信息展示工具，作为 neofetch 的现代替代品，专注于性能与可定制性。它支持 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 等十余种操作系统，提供美观的视觉输出与丰富的配置选项。适用于开发者、系统管理员在终端快速获取并展示系统详情，支持多种包管理器一键安装，社区活跃且持续维护更新。
repos.summary_en: Fastfetch is a high-performance system information tool written in C, designed as a modern, maintained alternative to neofetch with emphasis on performance and customizability. It supports over 10 operating systems including Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and various BSD variants, delivering visually appealing output with extensive configuration options. Ideal for developers and sysadmins to display system details in terminals, it offers easy installation via major package managers and maintains active community development with regular updates.

repos.description: Automate browser based workflows with AI
repos.summary_zh: Skyvern 是基于 LLM 和计算机视觉的智能浏览器自动化平台，提供 Playwright 兼容 SDK 和无代码工作流构建器。通过视觉理解替代 XPath 定位，支持未知网站自动化、布局变更自适应，实现跨站点工作流批量执行，显著提升自动化鲁棒性。
repos.summary_en: Skyvern automates browsers using LLMs and vision. Playwright SDK replaces XPath with visual understanding for resilient cross-site workflows.

repos.description: Chinese copywriting guidelines for better written communication／中文文案排版指北
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供全面的中文文案排版规范，系统性地统一中英文、数字间的空格规则，规范标点符号使用、全半角字符标准，以及专有名词正确大小写。旨在降低团队协作沟通成本，提升内容质量和网站专业气质。包含丰富实用示例和争议性案例讨论，并集成pangu.js等自动化工具实现规则检查。适用于网站、文档、UI界面等所有中文内容创作场景，是开发者、设计师和内容创作者的标准化必备参考指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive Chinese copywriting and typesetting guidelines, standardizing spacing between Chinese/English characters and numbers, proper punctuation usage, and correct capitalization. It aims to reduce team communication costs and enhance content quality. Includes practical examples, controversial edge cases, and integrates automation tools like pangu.js for rule enforcement. Essential for developers, designers, and content creators working with Chinese language content across websites, documentation, and UI interfaces.

repos.description: Plan, run and supervise fleets of agents from task to merged PR. Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) + iPhone & Android apps.  Supports Claude Code, Codex & 35+ coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Orchestrator 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于统一编排和监督多个编码 AI 智能体（支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 25+ 工具）。每个任务独立分配智能体、隔离工作区和 Git 分支，通过实时看板追踪 PR、CI 和评审全流程，实现从规划到合并的自动化协作开发。
repos.summary_en: Agent Orchestrator is a cross-platform desktop workspace for orchestrating and supervising teams of coding AI agents from planning to merge. It supports 25+ agent harnesses including Claude Code and Codex. Each task gets its own agent, isolated workspace, and dedicated Git branch. A live Kanban board tracks workers, pull requests, CI runs, and code reviews in real time. A local daemon monitors agent activity and source-control state, providing a unified project view instead of disconnected terminals and branches. It enables efficient parallel development across multiple coding agents.

repos.description: 📡 Your own AI-powered news radar. Generates daily briefings in English & Chinese. | 用 AI 构建你专属的新闻雷达
repos.summary_zh: AI驱动的新闻聚合雷达，自动抓取Hacker News、Reddit、RSS等多源资讯，通过Claude/GPT等模型进行去重、评分与摘要，生成个性化双语日报。支持自定义源、阈值与Feishu/邮件推送，保留人工筛选层，高效过滤信息噪音。
repos.summary_en: Horizon is an AI-powered news radar that automatically aggregates content from Hacker News, Reddit, RSS, Telegram, Twitter/X, and GitHub releases. It uses Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or Ollama models to deduplicate, score (0-10), summarize, and enrich stories with background context and community discussions. The tool generates personalized bilingual daily briefings delivered via Feishu, email, or web, featuring customizable sources, thresholds, and human-in-the-loop curation to filter noise while preserving trusted content.

repos.description: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.
repos.summary_zh: camofox-browser 是基于 Camoufox（C++ 层修改的 Firefox 内核）构建的反检测浏览器服务，专为 AI 智能体设计。它通过底层指纹欺骗（WebGL、AudioContext、硬件并发数等）绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬机制，提供 REST API 接口。相比 Playwright，内存占用低至 40MB，支持可访问性快照（比 HTML 小 90%）、会话隔离和搜索宏，是 Puppeteer/Playwright 的直接替代方案。
repos.summary_en: camofox-browser is a stealth headless browser service for AI agents, built on Camoufox—a Firefox fork with C++-level fingerprint spoofing. It bypasses Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping by patching navigator.hardwareConcurrency, WebGL, AudioContext, screen geometry, and WebRTC before JavaScript execution. Offering a REST API with 90% smaller accessibility snapshots than HTML, stable element refs, session isolation, search macros, and ~40MB idle memory, it serves as a drop-in replacement for Playwright/Puppeteer in AI automation and web scraping workflows.

repos.description: Automated penetration testing & attack surface management platform. Recon, scan, exploit, report - 600+ exploits, 90+ integrations, 10K+ detections.
repos.summary_zh: Sn1per是一款自动化渗透测试与攻击面管理平台，整合侦察、漏洞扫描、漏洞利用与报告生成于统一工作区。内置600+漏洞利用、90+工具集成与上万检测规则，支持Community到Enterprise多版本，适用于个人红队与SOC团队的全流程攻防作业。
repos.summary_en: Sn1per is an automated penetration testing and attack surface management platform that unifies recon, scanning, exploitation and reporting. It orchestrates 90+ tools, ships 600+ exploits and 10K+ detections, with Community to Enterprise editions for solo pentesters and global SOC teams.

repos.description: Agent skill that turns natural language, code, Terraform/K8s, SQL, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf and GraphQL sources into editable, tested draw.io architecture diagrams: incremental sync, multi-view projection, drift diff, CI architecture tests, whiteboard derasterize, interactive HTML/PPTX/Mermaid exports.
repos.summary_zh: drawio-skill 是一款 AI 驱动的技能，将自然语言描述转化为专业的 draw.io 图表。它支持 6 种预设类型（ERD、UML、序列、架构、ML/深度学习、流程图）、代码库（Python/JS/Go/Rust）结构可视化、10,000+ 官方形状搜索及 321 个 AI/LLM 品牌 logo。集成视觉自检与最多 5 轮迭代精炼，自动修复布局问题，支持 PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG 导出。与 Claude、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理兼容，适用于软件架构设计、代码可视化及系统文档生成场景。
repos.summary_en: drawio-skill is an AI agent skill that converts natural language into professional draw.io diagrams. It offers 6 presets (ERD, UML, Sequence, Architecture, ML/Deep Learning, Flowchart), codebase visualization for Python/JS/Go/Rust via Graphviz auto-layout, search across 10,000+ official shapes, and 321 AI/LLM logos. Features vision self-check with up to 5 rounds of refinement, auto-fixes layout issues, and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor and other agents, ideal for architecture design, code analysis, and LLM app documentation.

repos.description: 类似按键精灵的鼠标键盘录制和自动化操作 模拟点击和键入 | automate mouse clicks and keyboard input
repos.summary_zh: KeymouseGo 是一款轻量级跨平台自动化工具，通过录制鼠标键盘操作生成 JSON5 脚本并回放执行。支持 Windows/Linux/macOS，提供桌面 GUI 和命令行两种模式，可设定执行次数与热键控制。基于 Python 和 pynput 库开发，无需编程基础即可实现重复性办公、测试等任务的自动化，是精简绿色的按键精灵替代方案。
repos.summary_en: KeymouseGo is a lightweight cross-platform automation tool that records mouse and keyboard actions into JSON5 scripts for playback. Supporting Windows/Linux/macOS, it offers both GUI and CLI modes with configurable execution count and hotkeys. Built on Python and pynput, it enables automating repetitive tasks like office work and testing without programming knowledge, serving as a compact alternative to key wizard software.

repos.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs
repos.summary_zh: 融合怪(VPS Fusion Monster)是功能全面的服务器测评脚本，提供自动化硬件与网络基准测试。Go重构版本彻底解耦环境依赖，支持非root用户运行，兼容多架构(amd64/arm64等)与主流Linux发行版。核心功能涵盖CPU/内存/磁盘性能测试、三网回程路由追踪、多节点网速测试及15数据库IP质量检测。支持交互菜单与参数化无值守模式，可自定义Geekbench版本、磁盘测试工具等，专为开发者与运维人员设计的极致轻量高效测评方案。
repos.summary_en: Fusion Monster (ECS) is a comprehensive server testing script for VPS benchmarking. The Go-based implementation eliminates environment dependencies, supports non-root execution, and maintains compatibility across multiple architectures (amd64/arm64/i386/arm) and Linux distributions. Core capabilities include CPU/memory/disk performance evaluation, triple-network routing analysis, multi-node speed tests, and IP quality validation via 15 databases. Features both interactive menu and headless parameter-driven modes, with customizable options for Geekbench versions, disk test utilities, and China-specific network endpoints, designed for developers and sysadmins.

repos.description: 🤖 Keep your forks up-to-date via automated PRs
repos.summary_zh: Pull 是一款 GitHub App，通过自动化 PR 保持 fork 仓库与上游同步。基于 Deno 2.0 和 TypeScript 构建，支持 merge、squash、rebase 和硬重置等多种同步策略。可定时检测上游变更，自动创建 PR 并分配审查者，兼容分支保护规则。提供灵活的 YAML 配置，支持 GitHub Enterprise Server，解决了开发者维护 fork 时的手动同步痛点，提升开源协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Pull is a GitHub App that automates fork synchronization with upstream repositories via pull requests. Built on Deno 2.0 and TypeScript, it supports configurable merge strategies including merge, squash, rebase, and hard reset. The app periodically checks for upstream changes, automatically creates PRs with assignees and reviewers, and respects branch protection rules. With flexible YAML configuration and GitHub Enterprise Server support, it eliminates manual fork maintenance overhead and streamlines open-source collaboration workflows.

repos.description: ChatGPT 官网接口纯协议逆向实现，Go 语言编写，高并发、低内存、高性能。指纹级请求还原，支持 GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图、GIF 动图、文本模型与语音合成/转写，兼容 OpenAI 接口协议，在线批量生图，号池管理，支持导入 CPA、sub2api 号池，可接入 Cherry Studio、New API 等软件
repos.summary_zh: 本项目逆向ChatGPT官网接口，实现OpenAI兼容的图片生成与编辑API，支持gpt-image-2等模型。提供账号池管理、Docker自托管及在线画图功能，兼容Cherry Studio，适用于个人图像服务。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interfaces, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for image generation and editing using models like gpt-image-2. It features account pool management with automatic quota refresh, multiple import methods including CPA and sub2api, proxy support, and Docker self-hosting. Includes an online drawing workbench and compatibility with tools like Cherry Studio and New API. Ideal for personal, non-commercial image generation and editing services with sustained account usage.

repos.description: Find the local LLM that actually runs and performs best on your hardware. Ranked by real, recency-aware benchmarks, not parameter count. One command, run it instantly.
repos.summary_zh: whichllm 是一款命令行工具，自动检测 GPU/CPU/RAM，从 Hugging Face 筛选适配模型，基于 LiveBench、Chatbot Arena 等真实多源基准进行 recency-aware 排名，而非参数量或 VRAM 简单匹配。支持 GPU 模拟、升级对比、模型规划、聊天启动及 JSON 输出，一条 uvx 命令即可运行。核心价值是证据驱动的本地 LLM 推荐，帮助用户在硬件限制下选出性能最优模型。
repos.summary_en: whichllm is a CLI tool that auto-detects hardware (GPU/CPU/RAM) and ranks the best-fitting local LLMs from Hugging Face using aggregated real-world benchmarks like LiveBench and Chatbot Arena, with recency awareness rather than size or VRAM heuristics. It supports GPU simulation, upgrade comparisons, model planning, chat launching, and JSON output. Run instantly via one uvx command. Delivers evidence-graded recommendations for optimal performance on specific hardware.

repos.description: pierre’s open source code
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个来自PIERRE COMPUTER COMPANY的开源元仓库，作为公司开源项目的中央枢纽。该项目采用TypeScript技术栈，目前托管了两个核心开发者工具：Diffs（专业的代码差异分析平台）和Trees（先进的树形结构可视化软件）。作为官方开源门户，它提供统一的代码分发、技术文档和全球开发者支持服务，体现了现代软件企业对于开放协作、透明开发和社区驱动创新的核心理念。
repos.summary_en: This is an open-source meta-repository from PIERRE COMPUTER COMPANY, serving as a central hub for the organization's open-source initiatives and developer tools. Built with TypeScript, it currently hosts two core projects: Diffs (a sophisticated code diff analysis platform) and Trees (an advanced tree structure visualization software). As the company's official open-source portal, it provides unified code distribution, comprehensive documentation, and dedicated technical support channels for the global developer community, demonstrating modern software enterprises' commitment to open collaboration, transparent development practices, and community-driven innovation.

repos.summary_zh: Bypass Paywalls Clean for Chrome 是一款浏览器扩展，旨在帮助用户绕过新闻网站和在线出版物的付费墙限制。该扩展通过内容脚本和网络请求拦截技术，自动检测并规避付费订阅提示，使用户能够免费访问原本需要付费的内容。本仓库为扩展的专属支持与问题追踪平台，主代码已迁移至 gitflic.ru。
repos.summary_en: Bypass Paywalls Clean for Chrome is a browser extension designed to help users bypass paywalls on news sites and online publications. It employs content scripts and network request interception to automatically detect and circumvent paywall restrictions, allowing free access to premium content. This repository serves as the dedicated support and issue tracking platform, with the main codebase having been migrated to gitflic.ru.

repos.description: Undetected version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
repos.summary_zh: Patchright 是 Playwright 的补丁增强版，专为 Chromium 浏览器打造，作为可直接替换的 undetected 自动化框架。通过修复 Runtime.enable、命令行参数等常见泄漏，有效绕过 Cloudflare、Akamai、Kasada 等反爬系统，支持 Python、NodeJS 与 .NET，适用于高隐蔽性网页爬虫与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Patchright is a patched, undetected drop-in replacement for Playwright, focused on Chromium browsers. It fixes major detection leaks (Runtime.enable, automation flags, etc.) to bypass Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada and similar anti-bot systems. Available for Python, NodeJS and .NET, ideal for stealth web scraping and browser automation.

repos.description: 🏞️ PicX，免费、安全的一站式在线图片处理平台。
repos.summary_zh: PicX 是一款基于 GitHub API 的在线图床管理工具，无需下载安装即可使用。它支持拖拽上传、批量操作、图片压缩和水印处理，提供 Markdown/HTML 等多种链接格式。通过 GitHub OAuth 或 Token 认证，用户可将 GitHub 仓库作为免费图床，配合 jsDelivr 等 CDN 实现高速访问，是开发者和技术写作者的理想图片托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: PicX is a GitHub API-based online image hosting management tool that requires no download or installation. It supports drag-and-drop upload, batch operations, image compression, and watermarking, providing multiple link formats like Markdown/HTML. Through GitHub OAuth or Token authentication, users can leverage GitHub repositories as free image hosts, combined with CDNs like jsDelivr for high-speed access, making it an ideal image hosting solution for developers and technical writers.

repos.description: A browser extension that helps users publish content to multiple social media platforms with one click.
repos.summary_zh: 这款浏览器扩展MultiPost支持一键将内容同步发布到知乎、微博、小红书、抖音等10多个平台。无需任何登录或API Key，完全免费。提供扩展API和RESTful API便于开发者集成。解决了内容创作者跨平台发布的难题，提升效率。适用于社交媒体营销和内容自动化分发场景。
repos.summary_en: MultiPost is a browser extension that allows users to publish content such as text, images, and videos to over 10 social media platforms including Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin with just one click. No login, registration, or API key is needed, and the service is completely free. It provides an Extension API and a RESTful API for easy integration into web applications or scripts. This tool solves the challenges content creators face when posting across multiple platforms, greatly improving efficiency. It is ideal for social media marketing and automated content distribution scenarios, with a companion Markdown editor available.

repos.description: Something about tools
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个自动化系统重装工具集，核心为InstallNET.sh脚本，支持命令行一键网络重装Debian、Ubuntu、CentOS、AlmaLinux、RockyLinux、Kali、Alpine及Windows 11系统。适用于VPS和物理服务器快速部署，仅需wget即可运行，自动处理各发行版依赖差异。提供默认SSH/RDP配置，特别适合资源受限环境（Alpine仅需256MB内存），是运维人员批量管理和恢复系统的利器。
repos.summary_en: This is an automated system reinstallation toolkit centered around the InstallNET.sh script. It enables one-command network-based reinstallation of Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS, AlmaLinux, RockyLinux, Kali, Alpine Linux, and Windows 11 via command line. Designed for rapid VPS and bare-metal server deployment, it runs with minimal dependencies (wget only) and automatically handles distribution-specific package management differences. Provides default SSH/RDP configurations and is optimized for resource-constrained environments (Alpine requires just 256MB RAM), making it ideal for sysadmins managing batch operations and system recovery.

repos.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
repos.summary_zh: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
repos.summary_en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

repos.description: 😎 🔗 Awesome list about all kinds of resources for learning Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一份精心整理的网络安全学习资源大全，专为渗透测试和道德黑客入门者设计。收录从基础书籍到实战平台的完整体系，涵盖CTF挑战、漏洞实验室、恶意软件分析等核心领域。通过Hack The Box、TryHackMe等在线靶场，学习者可获真实渗透测试经验。项目强调实践导向，包含OSCP风格实验和权限提升专项训练，是构建网络安全知识体系的权威参考资料。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of comprehensive resources for learning ethical hacking and penetration testing. It covers foundational books, hands-on CTF platforms like Hack The Box and TryHackMe, vulnerable web applications, malware analysis tools, and Linux pentesting distributions. The repository features OSCP-style labs, privilege escalation workshops, and extensive vulnerability databases. Designed for structured skill development from beginner to advanced levels, it serves as an authoritative guide for building practical cybersecurity expertise through real-world scenarios and community-driven contributions.

repos.summary_zh: Google Gemini电脑使用预览版是基于Gemini 2.5模型的浏览器自动化代理工具。它通过自然语言指令直接控制浏览器执行搜索、填表等网页操作，集成Playwright实现本地浏览器控制，同时支持Vertex AI和Browserbase云端部署。开发者可通过Python CLI快速调用，体验Gemini模型的"计算机使用"能力，适用于网页自动化、测试和智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: The Google Gemini Computer Use Preview is a browser automation agent powered by the Gemini 2.5 model. It translates natural language instructions into executable browser actions like searching and form filling. The tool leverages Playwright for local browser control and supports cloud deployment via Vertex AI and Browserbase. Accessed through a Python CLI, it demonstrates Gemini's 'computer use' capability, enabling developers to automate web interactions, testing, and intelligent browsing tasks through simple text commands.

repos.description: Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go and 7+ native security tools.
repos.summary_zh: Pentest Swarm AI是首个基于真实群体架构的开源渗透测试工具，通过AI代理群协同完成侦察、分类、利用和报告全流程。支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和CTF模式，集成nmap、sqlmap、Burp等7+原生安全工具，兼容Claude、Ollama等多种大模型，采用ReAct推理实现真正自主化的安全测试。
repos.summary_en: Pentest Swarm AI is the first open-source penetration testing tool built on a real swarm architecture, orchestrating specialized AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting. Supporting bug bounty programs, continuous monitoring, and CTF competitions, it integrates 7+ native security tools including nmap, sqlmap, Burp, and Metasploit. Built with Go and ReAct reasoning, it's compatible with Claude, Ollama, and other LLMs, enabling truly autonomous security testing through stigmergic multi-agent coordination.

repos.description: Open source AI terminal for cloud and infrastructure management, enabling you to deploy, troubleshoot, and automate services using natural language and intelligent agents.
repos.summary_zh: Chaterm是一款AI原生的智能终端代理，旨在成为DevOps副驾驶。它通过自然语言交互重塑传统命令行体验，内置专家知识库和自主Agent引擎，可自动分解复杂任务并执行从日志分析到服务回滚的全链路操作。支持EC2、数据库和Kubernetes管理，提供智能上下文补全和移动端语音交互能力，消除技术栈认知壁垒，让开发者具备资深SRE的运维能力。
repos.summary_en: Chaterm is an AI-native intelligent terminal agent designed as a DevOps co-pilot. It revolutionizes the command-line experience through natural language interaction, featuring a built-in expert knowledge base and autonomous agent engine capable of planning and executing complex workflows from log analysis to service rollback. It manages EC2 instances, databases, and Kubernetes clusters while offering intelligent contextual completion and real-time voice interaction on mobile devices, empowering developers with SRE-level operational capabilities.

repos.description: Automatically crawl arXiv papers daily and summarize them using AI. Illustrating them using GitHub Pages.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具通过 GitHub Actions 每日自动爬取 arXiv 论文，并利用 DeepSeek AI 生成中文总结，完全无需服务器。提供个性化高亮、跨设备访问及 SKILL 可插拔过滤系统，帮助研究者零成本追踪 cs.CV、cs.AI 等领域最新进展，日均成本仅 0.2 元，支持偏好导出与一键部署。
repos.summary_en: This tool automatically crawls arXiv papers daily via GitHub Actions and generates Chinese summaries using DeepSeek AI, requiring zero server infrastructure. It offers personalized highlighting, cross-device compatibility, and a plug-and-play SKILL system for custom filtering, enabling researchers to track the latest advancements in cs.CV, cs.AI and other fields at near-zero cost (~0.2 CNY/day). Features include local preference storage, flexible date filtering, and seamless preference export for reproducible setups.

repos.description: A CLI for Twitter/X — feed, bookmarks, and user timeline in terminal
repos.summary_zh: 无需API密钥的Twitter/X终端客户端，支持浏览时间线、书签、搜索及发帖等完整功能。采用浏览器Cookie认证与TLS指纹模拟技术绕过检测，提供结构化JSON/YAML输出，专为AI智能体与自动化脚本设计，支持代理与速率限制规避。
repos.summary_en: Twitter/X CLI bypassing API keys via browser cookies and TLS spoofing. Full read/write operations with structured JSON/YAML output optimized for AI agents and automation scripts.

repos.description: A vector graphics application for structured SVG editing, available on all major desktop platforms and on web. Currently in late alpha.
repos.summary_zh: GodSVG 是一款结构化 SVG 编辑器，直接操作 SVG 源码而非添加元数据，实现 UI 与代码实时双向同步。生成干净、精确、优化的矢量文件，适合设计师与开发者对图形进行像素级控制。支持桌面与 Web 平台，目前处于晚期 alpha 阶段，强调低抽象工作流。
repos.summary_en: GodSVG is a structured SVG editor that fundamentally differs from traditional tools by directly manipulating SVG source code without metadata overhead. It enables real-time bidirectional sync between visual editing and code view, producing clean, precise, and highly optimized vector files. Designed for designers and developers requiring pixel-perfect control, it runs on desktop and web platforms in late alpha stage.

repos.description: Advanced Privacy Browser Core with Unified Fingerprint Defense: Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada, Shape, DataDome, PerimeterX, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, Imperva, reCAPTCHA, ThreatMetrix, Adscore
repos.summary_zh: BotBrowser是一款专注于反浏览器指纹追踪的隐私浏览器核心。基于最新Chromium构建，通过统一指纹防御技术，在Windows、macOS、Linux等跨平台环境下保持完全一致的指纹特征，有效对抗Cloudflare、Akamai、Kasada等31+种高级追踪检测机制。支持Playwright/Puppeteer集成，提供QUIC/STUN全代理网络栈和毫秒级独立指纹切换，性能损耗低于1%。适用于隐私研究、反欺诈测试和自动化工具开发。
repos.summary_en: BotBrowser is a privacy-first browser core engineered to neutralize browser fingerprinting across platforms. Built on the latest Chromium, it maintains identical fingerprint signatures on Windows, macOS, and Linux, defeating over 31 tracking systems including Cloudflare, Akamai, and Kasada. Key features include Playwright/Puppeteer integration with CDP leak blocking, full QUIC/STUN proxy tunneling, per-context fingerprint isolation with millisecond switching, and benchmark-proven performance parity with Chrome. Designed for privacy research and authorized defensive benchmarking.

repos.description: 专为已有 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 号码的用户设计的现代化 eSIM 管理工具集，支持将物理 SIM 卡转换为 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成。(A modern set of eSIM management tools designed specifically for users who already have Giffgaff and Simyo numbers, offering support for converting physical SIM cards to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation.)
repos.summary_zh: eSIM Tools 为 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 用户提供在线 eSIM 管理服务。支持物理 SIM 转 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成，全自动化 1-2 分钟完成。数据本地处理保障隐私，支持 PWA 离线使用。技术亮点为原生 JS、OAuth 认证和跨平台访问。
repos.summary_en: eSIM Tools is a modern online eSIM management toolset designed for existing Giffgaff and Simyo users. It supports converting physical SIMs to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation through fully automated processes that take only 1-2 minutes without customer support. All data is processed locally in the browser for privacy, with PWA support for offline use. Built with native JavaScript and no frameworks, it features OAuth 2.0 PKCE, SMS verification, and GraphQL integration. The tool is ideal for users switching devices or migrating to eSIM on compatible iOS and Android phones.

repos.description: codex-console 是一个集成化控制台项目，支持任务管理、批量处理、数据导出、自动上传、日志查看与打包支持。
repos.summary_zh: codex-console 是专为解决 OpenAI 注册链路不稳定性而生的增强版控制台。它修复了 Sentinel POW 验证、拆分注册登录流程、优化验证码处理，支持批量账号管理、Web UI 操作、多邮箱接码及 PostgreSQL。提供跨平台打包与 Docker 部署，是稳定获取 OpenAI Token 的自动化运维利器。
repos.summary_en: codex-console is an enhanced management console designed to address OpenAI registration instability. It fixes Sentinel POW verification, separates registration/login flows, and optimizes email verification handling. Featuring batch account management, Web UI, multi-email support, PostgreSQL, and cross-platform deployment, it's a robust automation tool for stable OpenAI token acquisition.

repos.description: Github Starred Repositories Manager
repos.summary_zh: Gitstars 是专为开发者设计的 GitHub 星标仓库管理工具。它解决了星标过多导致的查找难题，提供按主题/语言分类、README 预览和快速直达功能。内置的 Gitstars Ranking 每日更新 GitHub 星标 Top100 项目，支持按编程语言筛选，帮助开发者高效发现优质开源项目。支持 Vercel 一键部署，实现个人星标仓库的私有化智能管理。
repos.summary_en: Gitstars is a specialized GitHub starred repositories manager for developers. It addresses the challenge of finding repositories among numerous stars by offering categorization by topics/languages, README preview, and quick access. The built-in Gitstars Ranking updates daily with GitHub's top 100 starred projects across programming languages, enabling efficient discovery of quality open-source projects. One-click Vercel deployment enables private intelligent management of personal starred repositories.

repos.summary_zh: Isoflow 是基于 React 的开源网络图绘制组件，提供拖放编辑器、可扩展图标系统（支持 AWS/Azure 等云插件）和代码/图片导出功能。作为 MIT 许可的开源核心项目，社区版适用于 IT 基础设施可视化、云架构设计与网络拓扑规划场景。技术亮点在于灵活的插件机制与 React 组件的易集成性，助力快速构建专业网络文档。
repos.summary_en: Isoflow is an open-source React component for drawing network diagrams. It features a drag-and-drop editor, extensible icon system with plugins for AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and export options to code or images. As an MIT-licensed open-core project, the Community Edition is ideal for architecture visualization, infrastructure planning, and network topology scenarios. Highlights include plugin extensibility and seamless React integration.

repos.description: 专业的短剧剧本创作skill,从选题立项到分集撰写、质量自检、合规审核、海外出海，覆盖短剧剧本生产全流程。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI编程助手的短剧剧本创作技能包，覆盖选题立项到出海全流程。提供13种题材模板、四层反派体系、五种钩子类型和节奏曲线系统，支持双语格式与合规审查。通过结构化提示工程实现自动化剧本生产，大幅提升创作效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: This is a professional short drama screenplay creation skill package for AI programming assistants. It covers the complete workflow from topic selection to episode writing, quality review, compliance check, and overseas expansion. The tool provides 13 genre templates, a four-tier villain system, five hook types, and a rhythm curve system with paid content optimization. It supports both domestic and international formats with bilingual capabilities, featuring automated quality scoring and compliance review. Built on structured prompt engineering, it streamlines script creation, dramatically enhancing production efficiency while ensuring professional quality.

repos.description: Portable AI code quality reviews for Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents: six Agent Skills for architecture, technical debt, tests and remediation.
repos.summary_zh: brooks-lint是一款基于《人月神话》等12本经典工程书籍的AI代码审查工具。它诊断代码中的6种衰退风险，输出带书籍引用、严重性标签和修复建议的结构化发现。支持PR审查、架构审计、技术债务评估、测试套件审查及全扫自动修复等6种模式。作为Claude Code插件和Codex CLI技能集成，提供一致、可追溯的代码质量评估。适用于软件开发团队提升可维护性、降低技术债务，超越传统linter和纯AI审查。
repos.summary_en: brooks-lint is an AI-powered code review tool grounded in twelve classic engineering books including The Mythical Man-Month and Refactoring. It diagnoses code across six decay risks such as Cognitive Overload and Change Propagation, producing structured findings with book citations, severity labels, and actionable remedies. Featuring six analysis modes including PR reviews, architecture audits, tech debt assessments, test suite reviews, and full-sweep auto-fix, it integrates as a Claude Code plugin and Codex CLI skill. This delivers consistent, traceable code quality insights superior to plain LLMs or traditional linters, ideal for software teams improving maintainability and reducing technical debt.

repos.description: LuaN1aoAgent is a fully autonomous AI-driven penetration testing agent powered by graph-based cognitive reasoning.
repos.summary_zh: LuaN1aoAgent是基于DeepSeek V3.2的AI渗透测试智能体，采用P-E-R（规划-执行-反思）协作框架与因果图推理技术，模拟人类专家思维实现全自动漏洞挖掘。在XBOW基准测试中达到90.4%成功率，单次漏洞利用成本仅0.09美元，支持动态路径规划与持续学习进化，重塑自动化安全测试范式。
repos.summary_en: LuaN1aoAgent is an AI penetration testing agent powered by DeepSeek V3.2, featuring the P-E-R (Planner-Executor-Reflector) framework and causal graph reasoning. It simulates human expert cognition for fully autonomous vulnerability discovery, achieving 90.4% success rate on XBOW benchmark at a median cost of $0.09 per exploit. Its dynamic planning and continuous learning capabilities redefine automated security testing.

repos.description: Realm 全功能一键中转脚本，终端可视化界面构建网络转发服务.Realm: Full-featured one-click network relay — configure and manage forwarding rules from an interactive TUI.
repos.summary_zh: 纯Shell脚本实现的Realm全功能网络中转管理工具，提供交互式TUI界面一键配置转发规则。同步官方最新特性（TCP/UDP、WS/WSS/TLS隧道、MPTCP、多入口多出口、Proxy Protocol），并扩展负载均衡、故障转移、端口流量监控限速与网络链路测试，支持多发行版与离线安装，极简高效搭建中转服务器。
repos.summary_en: A pure Shell-script tool for full-featured Realm network relay management with an interactive TUI. Syncs all official Realm capabilities (TCP/UDP, WS/WSS/TLS tunnels, MPTCP, multi-entry/exit, Proxy Protocol) and adds load balancing, failover, port traffic monitoring/limiting, and link testing. Supports multiple distros and offline install for lightweight relay server setup.

repos.description: Python library for Agentic Document Extraction (ADE).
repos.summary_zh: LandingAI ADE Python库提供智能文档提取能力，支持同步/异步调用与大规模文档处理。基于Pydantic构建全类型SDK，内置指数退避重试机制，可插拔HTTP后端。通过MCP服务器无缝集成AI助手，实现文档结构化数据提取自动化。适用于金融、法律、医疗等领域的非结构化文档转结构化数据场景，提升数据处理效率。
repos.summary_en: LandingAI ADE Python library enables intelligent document extraction via agentic AI. Features fully-typed SDK with Pydantic models, sync/async clients, and built-in exponential backoff retries. Supports large document processing through async jobs and pluggable HTTP backends (httpx/aiohttp). MCP server integration allows AI assistants to interact with the API seamlessly. Ideal for automating structured data extraction from unstructured documents in finance, legal, healthcare and other domains, transforming PDFs and images into machine-readable JSON with schema-based precision, high reliability and production-ready performance.

repos.description: Free open-source Multilogin/Incogniton/Kameleo alternative for fingerprint spoofing (Canvas/WebGL/User-Agent). Perfect for Selenium/Playwright/Puppeteer automation, web scraping, social media bots, ads verification, and multi-accounting based on chromium. Avoid bans, bypass anti-bot systems, and prevent tracking with customizable stealth browsing
repos.summary_zh: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser 是一款基于 Chromium 的开源反检测浏览器，提供全面的指纹欺骗能力，覆盖 Canvas、WebGL、字体等关键维度。其独家一致性分析引擎确保所有欺骗字段逻辑自洽，有效绕过反机器人系统。内置自动化模块完美兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer，适用于网络爬虫、社交媒体多账号运营及广告验证等场景，是 Multilogin 等商业方案的开源替代。
repos.summary_en: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser is an open-source anti-detection browser built on Chromium that delivers comprehensive fingerprint spoofing for Canvas, WebGL, fonts, and more. Its exclusive consistency analysis engine ensures logical alignment across all spoofed fields to effectively bypass anti-bot systems. With built-in automation modules fully compatible with Playwright/Puppeteer, it's ideal for web scraping, social media multi-account management, and ad verification, offering a powerful free alternative to commercial solutions like Multilogin.

repos.description: Terminal UI to get stuff done in the browser
repos.summary_zh: Browser Use Terminal 是一个基于 Rust 的终端 UI 工具，用于让 LLM 代理自动化控制浏览器完成真实任务。它通过直接 CDP 连接操作真实 Chrome 会话，支持无头模式和云端执行，提供可交互的终端界面来观察、控制和恢复任务。核心优势在于 2倍成本效益和速度提升，适用于需要认证状态的企业 Web 应用自动化。
repos.summary_en: Browser Use Terminal is a Rust-based TUI that enables LLM agents to automate browser tasks via direct CDP control. It leverages real Chrome sessions with existing login states, supports headless and cloud execution, and offers an interactive interface for task monitoring and intervention. The custom LLM harness achieves 2x cost reduction and performance gains, perfect for complex authenticated web workflows.

repos.summary_zh: AegisFlow 是本地运行的 GLM Coding 支付运营后台，支持多账号导入、套餐同步、腾讯验证码自动 OCR 识别与链路处理、预览下单签单生成二维码及定时任务启动。基于 FastAPI 后端与 Node.js 构建，集成内置 Python 代理池，实现全自动化支付流程，适合本地多账号管理和运营效率提升。
repos.summary_en: AegisFlow is a locally running payment operations backend for GLM Coding, supporting multi-account import/sync, automatic Tencent captcha OCR recognition and processing chains, order preview/signing for QR code generation, and scheduled task launching. Built with FastAPI backend and Node.js, featuring built-in Python proxy pool for fully automated payment workflows, ideal for local multi-account management and operational efficiency.

repos.description: Secure, production-grade IoT hydroponic automation system with ESP32, MQTT telemetry, and real-time dashboard
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个生产级开源物联网水培自动化系统，基于ESP32硬件和MQTT协议实现pH、EC、温湿度等环境参数实时监测与智能控制。系统采用React+Node.js构建边缘优先的实时仪表板，通过InfluxDB存储时序数据，支持TLS加密通信和RSA签名OTA更新，填补了业余DIY与工业级自动化之间的空白。
repos.summary_en: HydroponicOne is a production-grade open-source IoT automation system for hydroponic farming, built on ESP32 hardware and MQTT telemetry protocol. It enables real-time monitoring and automated control of critical parameters including pH, EC, water level, temperature, and humidity through smart relays for dosing pumps, lights, and ventilation. The system features an edge-first React dashboard with WebSocket communication, enterprise-grade security with TLS encryption and RSA-2048 signed OTA updates, and dual-database architecture (PostgreSQL for config, InfluxDB for time-series data). It bridges the gap between hobbyist DIY setups and expensive industrial automation solutions.

repos.description: Automated account registration toolkit for x.ai (Grok) with SSO extraction, OAuth Device Flow, and auto-replenish daemon
repos.summary_zh: 针对x.ai Grok的自动化账号注册工具包，支持curl_cffi引擎注册、YesCaptcha解决Turnstile、SSO令牌提取与OAuth Device Flow铸造、自动补充与令牌刷新守护进程，便于对接API网关账号池。
repos.summary_en: Automated x.ai (Grok) account registration toolkit with curl_cffi engine, YesCaptcha Turnstile solving, SSO-to-CPA token minting via OAuth Device Flow, auto-replenish and token-refresh daemons for API gateway account pools.

repos.description: 一款功能强大的 Nginx 配置文件可视化编辑工具
repos.summary_zh: nginx-flow 是一款基于 React Flow 的 Nginx 配置可视化编辑器，通过拖拽式画布构建 server/location/upstream 节点，实现配置即编程。内置生产级模板库覆盖 SPA、反向代理、负载均衡等场景，集成智能体检引擎可自动检测安全风险与性能问题并提供一键修复，支持实时配置预览与流量模拟，显著提升运维效率与配置准确性。
repos.summary_en: nginx-flow is a visual Nginx config editor built on React Flow, transforming manual configuration into drag-and-drop canvas programming with server/location/upstream nodes. It features production-ready templates for SPA, reverse proxy, load balancing, and smart audit engine that auto-detects security risks and performance issues with one-click fixes. Real-time config preview, traffic simulation, and bilingual support streamline DevOps workflows, reducing errors and accelerating deployment.

repos.summary_zh: soundshuman是反AI写作痕迹（slop）工具集，整合多款开源humanizer精华：Markdown技能像人类编辑重写文本（41种模式+统计特征+声线校准，禁止捏造），JSON规则包供机器强制执行，零依赖Node CLI实现全文评分、分析、修复与仓库扫描，并支持CI门禁与pre-commit钩子。目标是可检查工作流——可见规则、可解释分数、可审查diff，而非对抗检测器。适用于文档、博客、代码仓库内容质量把控与AI智能体写作。
repos.summary_en: soundshuman is an anti-AI-slop toolkit that merges the best of existing humanizers: a Markdown skill that rewrites prose like a careful human editor (41 patterns, statistical tells, voice calibration, no fabrication), a machine-enforceable JSON rule pack, and a zero-dependency Node CLI for scoring, analyzing, fixing, and scanning entire repos with CI gates and pre-commit hooks. It prioritizes an inspectable workflow—visible rules, explainable scores, reviewable diffs—over beating detectors. Ideal for docs, blogs, and keeping AI agents’ output natural.

repos.description: the best diff viewer ever made
repos.summary_zh: comview 是一款专为终端设计的现代化 diff 查看器，可美化渲染 unified diff 输出。深度集成 git 与 GitHub CLI，支持实时 watch 模式自动刷新。提供完整的 Vim 风格快捷键、注释系统、主题切换和文本对象操作，让代码审查无需离开终端即可获得类 GUI 的流畅体验，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: comview is a sophisticated terminal diff viewer that elegantly renders unified diffs with syntax highlighting and side-by-side view options. It deeply integrates with git and GitHub CLI, featuring a real-time watch mode for automatic updates. The tool provides complete Vim-style navigation, persistent comment storage in JSON format, customizable themes, and intuitive text object operations. Specifically designed for developers who live in the terminal, it eliminates the need for web-based tools by delivering a powerful, keyboard-driven code review experience that significantly enhances productivity and workflow efficiency.

repos.description: Markdown editor that gets out of your way. Lightweight, fast, portable. First release of https://4worlds.dev
repos.summary_zh: Inkwell是基于Rust+Tauri v2构建的轻量级Markdown编辑器，主打离线运行与极速启动（<1秒）。支持Mermaid图表、LaTeX公式、GitHub Flavored Markdown，提供4种主题与专注模式。100%本地存储，零遥测，安装包仅5-12MB。适用于跨平台写作，免费版功能完整，Pro版解锁PDF/HTML导出。
repos.summary_en: Inkwell is a sovereign Markdown editor built with Rust+Tauri v2, delivering <1s startup and offline-first operation. Features Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, GitHub Flavored Markdown, 4 themes, focus mode, and version history. 100% local storage, zero telemetry, 5-12MB footprint. Cross-platform for distraction-free writing. Free forever, Pro adds PDF/HTML export.

repos.description: 将ai studio的对话页面转发为api接口，供其他软件使用。您可以在releases中使用稳定版本和开发测试版
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过油猴脚本与本地 Python 服务器协同，将 AI Studio 对话页面桥接为 OpenAI API 兼容接口。核心亮点是完整支持函数调用（Function Calling）和动态模型列表获取，实现端到端自动化。用户可定义工具，AI 自动触发调用并返回结构化响应，支持并行调用与流式返回，无缝集成现有开发工具链。
repos.summary_en: This project bridges AI Studio chat pages into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces through Tampermonkey scripts and local Python servers. Its core innovation lies in full Function Calling support and dynamic model fetching, enabling complete end-to-end automation. Users can define custom tools that AI automatically triggers based on context, receiving structured responses with parallel invocation and streaming output. The system handles the entire interaction loop—from tool execution to result submission—providing a standardized API layer that seamlessly integrates with existing development toolchains, libraries, and workflows without modification.

repos.description: Find and track available single-word domains from your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: 终端CLI工具，用于快速查找可用单词域名。直接通过RDAP与WHOIS查询注册表，支持单词多TLD检查或扫描内置11822个品牌词列表，结果本地SQLite持久化并支持断点续扫。提供过滤排序、价格查询与交互式界面，严格区分available/registered/unknown状态，适合域名猎人与开发者高效发现优质域名。
repos.summary_en: Terminal CLI tool to find available single-word domains. Queries registries directly via RDAP and WHOIS, supports single-word multi-TLD checks or scanning 11,822 bundled brandable words. Results stored in local SQLite with resumable scans, filters, pricing and interactive TUI. Strictly separates available/registered/unknown states for reliable discovery by domain hunters and developers.

repos.description: Disposable, ephemeral network infrastructure powered by GitHub Codespaces.
repos.summary_zh: Fluffy-Barnacle利用GitHub Codespaces快速部署一次性网络基础设施，提供SOCKS5代理、HTTPS文件托管和WireGuard隧道。专为渗透测试设计，支持多区域部署、自动重连及Burp Suite集成，实现免费临时的出口IP轮换，显著提升安全研究效率。
repos.summary_en: Fluffy-Barnacle transforms GitHub Codespaces into ephemeral network infrastructure, deploying SOCKS5 proxies, HTTPS file hosting, and WireGuard tunnels in seconds. Designed for penetration testing, it features multi-region deployment, auto-reconnection, and Burp Suite integration. Each Codespace rotation provides fresh egress IPs, enabling efficient, policy-compliant security research and network operations.

repos.description: Script to submit both IPv6 and IPv4 addresses to DuckDNS
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本解决DuckDNS不支持IPv6自动更新的问题，通过Shell实现IPv4/IPv6双栈地址自动提交。自动检测NAT环境，一键配置并创建cron定时任务，适用于家庭服务器和物联网设备。轻量级设计，依赖curl等基础工具，确保在提供服务的设备上直接运行。
repos.summary_en: This script resolves DuckDNS's lack of IPv6 auto-update support by automatically submitting both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses via Shell. It detects NAT environments, provides one-click configuration with automated cron job setup, and is ideal for home servers and IoT devices. Lightweight design relies on curl and standard tools, ensuring direct execution on service-providing devices.

repos.description: Generated files for SuttaCentral editions
repos.summary_zh: SuttaCentral 发布系统生成的佛教经典数字版本文件库。存储多语言、多格式的巴利语三藏及注释文献，为网站和移动应用提供结构化内容支持。核心价值在于实现佛学文献的自动化发布、跨格式转换与国际化分发。
repos.summary_en: Repository containing generated digital edition files for SuttaCentral. Stores multilingual, multi-format Pali Canon and commentarial texts, providing structured content for web and mobile applications. Core value lies in automated publishing, cross-format conversion, and international distribution of Buddhist scriptures.

repos.description: 一键从 GitHub 跳转到 CodeWiki & DeepWiki & Zread 的油猴脚本 |  A one-click Tampermonkey script for jumping from GitHub to CodeWiki & DeepWiki & Zread
repos.summary_zh: 该油猴脚本为 GitHub 仓库页面添加一键跳转至 CodeWiki、DeepWiki 和 Zread 的快捷入口，无缝集成原生 UI。核心价值在于打通代码托管平台与 AI 增强的代码知识图谱服务，显著提升开发者查阅开源项目时的理解效率，无需手动复制链接即可获取智能生成的代码文档与架构分析。
repos.summary_en: This Tampermonkey script adds one-click jump links to CodeWiki, DeepWiki, and Zread directly on GitHub repository pages. It seamlessly integrates with the native UI, bridging code hosting platforms with AI-powered code intelligence services. The tool dramatically improves developer productivity by enabling instant access to AI-generated documentation and architecture analysis without manual link copying.

repos.description: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
repos.summary_zh: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
repos.summary_en: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.

repos.description: 批量查询 eu.org 域名是否被注册，在茫茫域名中，寻找自己心仪的那一枚。
repos.summary_zh: ScanDomainEuorg 是一款专注于 eu.org 域名批量查询的自动化工具。通过高效扫描技术，快速检测海量域名注册状态，已注册域名显示关联用户名，未注册显示 None。适用于域名投资者、个人开发者及企业品牌保护，帮助用户从海量域名中精准定位可注册的心仪域名，提升筛选效率。
repos.summary_en: ScanDomainEuorg is a specialized automation tool designed for batch querying eu.org domain registration status. Leveraging efficient scanning technology, it rapidly checks massive domain lists, clearly displaying usernames for registered domains and None for unregistered ones. This tool is essential for domain investors, individual developers, and enterprises conducting brand protection, enabling users to precisely identify desirable available domains from vast candidates and dramatically improving domain research efficiency while saving significant time and effort.

repos.description: SubSonic 是一款兼具桌面级体验与服务器级性能的高性能子域名扫描器。它采用 Go 和 Vue 构建，通过自适应并发算法和两阶段扫描机制确保了扫描的速度与准度，并最终编译为单一可执行文件，实现真正的“开箱即用”.
repos.summary_zh: SubSonic是一款高性能子域名扫描平台，采用Go与Vue构建，编译为单一可执行文件实现开箱即用。核心亮点包括自适应并发调度算法、两阶段扫描机制（主扫描+错误重试）、分层DNS解析及WebSocket实时Web UI，支持低内存运行与可视化监控。适用于网络安全渗透测试、子域名枚举与漏洞侦察场景，兼顾速度、稳定性和准确性。
repos.summary_en: SubSonic is a high-performance subdomain scanner combining desktop-grade UX with server-level performance. Built with Go and Vue, it compiles into a single executable for out-of-the-box use. Key features include an adaptive concurrency algorithm, two-phase scanning (main scan plus error retry), layered DNS resolution, and real-time WebSocket-powered web UI with live updates and low memory footprint. Ideal for cybersecurity penetration testing, subdomain enumeration, and reconnaissance, balancing speed, stability, and accuracy.

repos.summary_zh: jdapi 是一个非官方的京东 API Python 封装库，为开发者提供便捷的京东账号自动化操作能力。项目核心价值在于简化京东登录态管理、签到任务、优惠券领取等常见场景的 API 调用，通过 Python 函数式接口屏蔽底层 HTTP 请求细节。技术亮点包括自动 Cookie 管理、请求加密处理以及反反爬机制，适用于京东生态的自动化脚本开发与轻量级应用集成。
repos.summary_en: jdapi is an unofficial Python wrapper for JD.com APIs, enabling automated account operations with minimal code. It simplifies common scenarios like check-ins, coupon claiming, and order queries by abstracting HTTP complexities into Python functions. Key features include automated cookie management, request encryption, and anti-anti-crawling mechanisms, ideal for building JD ecosystem automation scripts and lightweight integrations.
